title: Quickstart Journey Graphics Revamp
creator: Amaya Torres
description: Refresh the visual assets and screenshots used on the Quickstart landing page: new hero illustration, simplified 3-step process diagram, modular screenshot frames for product screenshots, and motion specs for light animation. Goal is to increase new user activation by making the entry flow clearer, reduce cognitive load for first-time explorers, and standardize deliverables for engineering handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Hero illustration exported in SVG and 2x PNG with accessible alt text and 3 responsive breakpoints (mobile/tablet/desktop)
3-step diagram simplified to icon + short copy per step; available as SVG and annotated PNGs for dev implementation
Screenshot templates produced for 5 product states (empty account, first request, streaming response, settings panel, billing overview) with overlay callouts and production-safe data
Motion spec documented (duration, easing, reduced-motion alternative) and prototyped in Figma
Assets uploaded to Drive and referenced in the rollout PR; engineering confirms feasible exports and CSS hooks
deliverables: Hero illustration: SVG + 2 PNG sizes + alt text copy
3-step diagram: SVG + annotated PNG + low-fidelity inline copy variants
5 screenshot states exported at 1x and 2x with callout layers separated
Motion spec sheet (duration/easing/reduced-motion), Lottie JSON if needed
Implementation notes document with CSS class hooks and recommended responsive breakpoints
tasks: Finalize hero illustration and microcopy (DES review)
Export responsive assets and compress PNGs (prepare for CDN)
Produce screenshot templates using sanitized production data and generated test account outputs
Hand off annotated Figma frames to ENG with a short walkthrough recording
Address accessibility checklist (contrast, alt text, reduced motion) and sign off
decisions: Use simplified geometric illustration style to match console visual language instead of photographic screenshots
Limit hero animation to a single 300ms slide+fade to reduce complexity and support reduced-motion users
Adopt 3-step format: Connect, Configure, Ship (short copy finalized in comment thread)
Provide both SVG icons and inline PNG fallbacks for legacy browsers; engineering to prefer SVG where supported
review_feedback: PM (Jules Park) asked to tighten microcopy for step 2; suggested replacing 'tune' with 'configure' for clarity
ENG (Ravi Patel) requested exported PNGs with transparent backgrounds and separate overlay layers for callouts
Accessibility reviewer (Sasha Nguyen) requested contrast check for step icons against background and confirmed alt text phrasing
Design lead (Nora Ivanov) suggested reducing detail in the hero to improve legibility at small sizes

Ensure screenshot overlays align with live DOM elements; provide screenshot test cases for empty and filled states
